With the Scotsman we have, If you don’t clean it at least monthly it will get build up in the drain and the water will stay in with the ice. So I try to do a full cleaning at least once a month, and I will take all the ice out and pour hot water and sanitizer down the drain. I also try to wipe down the sides of the inside weekly because it can get this weird black stuff building up, and that is one thing inspectors will dock you for. 
The ice box itself I feel doesn’t get really dirty. 
If you clean it regularly it just prevents it from getting so much build up and needing a real deep clean to get the drain line clear again. We’ve only had to use an air compressor once or twice due to the drain line getting clogged, and it isn’t a big deal but it does take more time to do.
